summary: Iteration 51 — server-side order search on /api/v2/orders and /api/inventory/orders. Verified end-to-end via pytest (12/12) and Playwright for Admin, Sales Manager, and Inventory Manager. Debounce, page-reset, clear button, RBAC scoping, and regex-escape all confirmed. Regression smoke on pending-credits endpoint passes.
critical_code_review_comments: OrdersPanel.js: fetchOrders depends on `page`, but the useEffect that resets page-to-1 on debouncedQ change only fires when debouncedQ !== '' — clearing to empty won't reset page. Minor UX issue: if user searched on page 3, cleared, they stay on page 3. Consider `useEffect(()=>setPage(1),[debouncedQ])` unconditionally.

server.py get_inventory_orders sales_manager_id branch sets query['created_by'] BEFORE the q block; if q is provided the query is unaffected — good. But note it doesn't include assistant SM's own id in team scope where applicable (already there — verified).

upgrades.py — when both status filter AND q are combined, the query merges cleanly via $and only if $or already exists. Current logic ok, but the $and merge branch is untested by seed data (both filters mutually exclusive in existing seed). test_search_combined_with_status covers no-500 but doesn't assert exact results.
